responsibility: Defines GCC’s core typed profile data abstractions: the profile_quality lattice plus the profile_probability and profile_count classes used throughout CFG, IPA, and optimization passes. The header provides inline arithmetic and scaling operations, named probabilities, quality conversions for guessed/AFDO/adjusted/precise counts, compatibility rules, probability derivation from counts, and interfaces for streaming and legacy frequency conversion. It is the foundational representation layer for execution counts and branch probabilities across the compiler.
same_name_distinction: This header defines the profile_quality enum and the profile_count/profile_probability types with their core inline arithmetic, scaling, and conversion interfaces used throughout GCC. Unlike gcc/profile-count.cc, it is the representation and API definition for typed profile values, not the main home of out-of-line helpers, streaming code, and debug/formatting implementations.
